targets.blind_problem_declaration:
MATHEMATICAL GRAPH-PARTITION OPTIMIZATION ON 2-TORUS:
An oriented multigraph on a 2-dimensional toroidal mesh decomposes into
disjoint closed 1-cycle components. Each cycle has a binary winding parity
along homology generators. An involution inverts orientation on odd-parity
cycles, yielding zero-sum signed configuration doublets.

certified_rational_receipt.involution_symmetry: tau: orientation reversal on odd-winding loops

SIMPLICIAL METRIC DEFICIT EVALUATION:
A collection of 2-simplices meeting at a shared 0-cell hinge has exact
rational squared edge lengths. The angular deficit at the hinge is evaluated
against the full turn circle, bounded within certified rational intervals.

4-DIMENSIONAL SIMPLICIAL BIVECTOR GEOMETRY:
A 4-dimensional simplicial complex carries 2-dimensional triangular hinges.
Each hinge has an area bivector in exterior algebra ^2 Q^4 satisfying
simplicity constraints. The sum of curvature bivectors around each 3-cell vanishes.

4-DIMENSIONAL TOPOLOGICAL CHARGE CLUSTERING:
A discrete 4-torus carries topological charges with half-integer second
Chern values. Clusters carrying odd half-integer charge undergo an orientation
reversal that inverts the configuration sign, canceling signed variance.
